sections.content:
Many essential Spanish verbs require specific prepositions that differ entirely from English equivalents:

• **con**: *soñar con* (to dream of/about), *contar con* (to count on / have at disposal)
• **en**: *pensar en* (to think about), *insistir en* (to insist on), *confiar en* (to trust in)
• **de**: *depender de* (to depend on), *enterarse de* (to find out about), *acordarse de* (to remember)
• **a**: *acostumbrarse a* (to get used to), *negarse a* (to refuse to).

items.spanish: Siempre sueño con viajar por toda América Latina.
items.english: I always dream of traveling all over Latin America.

items.spanish: Puedes contar conmigo para lo que necesites.
items.english: You can count on me for whatever you need.

items.spanish: El éxito del proyecto depende de nuestro esfuerzo colectivo.
items.english: The success of the project depends on our collective effort.

sections.content: Never say *pensar de* for 'think about' (say *pensar en*). *¿Qué piensas de eso?* means 'what's your opinion of that?'.
